ashby:qumulo:983bc138-1779-4c34-94f7-1a3.full_description:
Qumulo’s cloud data platform manages exabytes of the world’s most demanding data, unifying files, objects, and every workload across edge, core, and cloud.


About the Senior Salesforce Administrator (GTM) position:

In this role you’ll own Salesforce for Qumulo’s global Go-To-Market organization - every lead, quote, order, and renewal runs through your platform. Your focus is to keep it clean, make it easy to use, and actively work shape it around how the business sells to reduce friction and improve outcomes across the board. 

This is a highly visible role with real ownership. Salesforce and other GTM systems are yours to run and improve, and you’ll have a say in how the entire GTM tech stack comes together. The changes you make will improve our end-to-end sales process: from how quickly quotes become bookings to how much time sellers get back for other tasks.  Reporting to our Senior Manager of Sales Technology, you'll work directly with Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Success to build and configure the systems that allow their teams to work effectively and efficiently. 

This role is based in our Cork city-center office, alongside world-class engineering and commercial teams. Reflecting the caliber of this role, we're offering a strong salary and benefits package, including pre-IPO stock options, a flexible schedule, and a home internet allowance.

What you’ll do:

 - Own Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Revenue Cloud/CPQ, and Experience Cloud.

 - Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success leaders to shape Salesforce around how their teams work.

 - Restructure our processed as the business changes, and own the data quality rules that keep it clean.

 - Run intake for sales technology requests. Help decide what we build, buy, or retire.

 - Lead GTM systems projects, such as new platform rollouts and product introductions.

 - Write the specs and user stories behind each change, then test them with the people who asked.

 - Automate manual work for sellers, leveraging AI tools to find the best way to build it.

 - Define integration requirements with our engineering and data teams.

 - Support lead-to-cash in Salesforce. When the numbers disagree with NetSuite, find out why.

 - Run the GTM support queue and manage releases with IT, including user training.

What we’re looking for:

 - You’ve been a hands-on Salesforce admin for 5+ years at a B2B company, and you hold the Salesforce Administrator certification.

 - Sales Cloud and CPQ or Revenue Cloud are platforms you’ve run in production.

 - You’ve led an enterprise systems implementation, or played a major part in one - ideally you’ve replatformed or restructured a Salesforce org.

 - You already use AI at work, and you can show us something you built with it.

 - You know APIs well enough to spec an integration and troubleshoot it when it fails.

 - You can keep regular hours that overlap with our US team.

 - Bonus if you build in Flow or have shipped an AI agent to production, know NetSuite, write SQL or Python, hold Advanced Admin or CPQ certification, and/or have worked for a company that sells through channel partners.

This is a hybrid role (3 days per week) based out of our Cork office. The annual pay range for the role is EUR €90,000 - €130,000 plus benefits and pre-IPO stock options. Individual pay depends on various factors, such as role level, relevant experience, and skills.

Qumulo opened its European R&D hub in Cork in March 2026. The team here works the way the whole company does: we act as owners and share by default. You’ll work alongside the engineers and commercial teams whose work runs through your systems.



About Qumulo:
Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations.

With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission-critical workloads anywhere real-time access to massive file datasets is non-negotiable. Qumulo delivers radical simplicity, hardware freedom, exceptional customer support, and a true hybrid-cloud architecture.

Our Values: 
At Qumulo, we are building an open and collaborative culture where people can do their best work with customers as our magnetic field. We act as owners, we share by default, we are data driven and experimental and as an inclusive workplace, we encourage and celebrate multiple points of view. As part of our culture we believe diversity drives innovation.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Qumulo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law. For more information on Qumulo's Applicant Privacy Policy, please visit: https://qumulo.com/applicant-employee-privacy-notice

Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager, PWS New Ventures


On-site


Cork, Ireland or Lausanne, Switzerland


The Role 


As the Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager for New Ventures, PWS Business Group, you will play a central role in building and scaling new categories.


This role will drive global B2B & B2C portfolio and marketing strategy development and transform the assigned category by identifying portfolio gaps and growth opportunities, defining high-impact go-to-market strategies and new launch models, and creating effective marketing programs that drive growth.


Reporting to the Head of Business & Marketing for PWS New Ventures, this role requires being on-site 3 days a week as standard and flexibility to travel up to 20% of the time.


Your Impact 


Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you'll need for success at Logitech. 

In this role you will:

  • Lead new product development and launch from the Portfolio and Marketing side, including business case development and end-to-end commercial launch readiness
  • Develop new GTM models, GTM plans, and sales enablement tools for bringing products to the market with maximum impact in B2B and B2C
  • Create B2B and B2C marketing campaigns and toolkits supporting new product launches, category scale phases, and partnerships
  • Partner with the Logitech for Business team, central marketing team, channel partners, and regional marketing teams to implement integrated marketing campaigns
  • Track and analyze business and marketing performance metrics, continuously optimizing for effectiveness and business objectives
  • Define global portfolio strategy and key business drivers, own the financial and market performance analysis
  • Build strong understanding of the target audience
  • Own competitive & market intelligence and market trends assessment, be seen as a category expert and a go-to spokesperson, internally and externally
  • Develop and evolve B2B and B2C new best practices and fit-for-use requirements

Key Qualifications


To be considered for this position you demonstrate:

  • Experience in global brand and portfolio management roles with a strong innovation and consumer-centricity culture
  • Strong command of Digital Marketing, Search and AEO/LLM optimization
  • Experience with sales enablement and B2B-first launches is a big plus
  • Experience of leading creative and production agencies on through-the-line global marketing campaign development, from briefing to creative development and production to toolkit assets creation
  • Genuine passion for technology and innovation, with strong grasp of emerging technology trends
  • Strong market, competitor, and business analysis skills, with portfolio management expertise and fluency in market data, competitive intelligence, and financial/business KPIs
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in highly agile, fast-moving, multidisciplinary teams across cultures and time zones 
  • Outcome-oriented self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, high degree of perseverance, ability to deal with ambiguity
  • High degree of flexibility and ability to fluidly transition between business & marketing, strategic & operational tasks
  • Fast learner, with a proven track record of creating scalable best practices
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
  • Fluent English

Hybrid role - 2 days per week on site.

Sr. Procurement Manager – Indirect Procurement


We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sr. Procurement Manager to join our Indirect Procurement organization. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to senior business leaders, including C-suite and executive stakeholders, helping shape how the organization manages third-party spend and creates sustainable business value.


You will own and lead strategic sourcing and category management initiatives across key areas of indirect spend, challenging established ways of working, identifying new opportunities, and bringing innovative procurement solutions to the business.


This role combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and strong execution. You will use market intelligence, data analytics, enterprise AI, and data storytelling to turn complex spend and market insights into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnering & Stakeholder Influence

  • Act as a trusted procurement advisor to C-suite and senior business leaders, providing strategic insights, commercial recommendations, and opportunities to optimize third-party spend.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across functions, developing a deep understanding of business priorities, challenges, and growth plans.
  • Proactively challenge existing practices and assumptions, bringing external market perspectives, innovative solutions, and best-in-class procurement thinking to the organization.
  • Influence decision-making at the highest levels, balancing business requirements, commercial objectives, risk, and long-term value.
  • Partner with stakeholders to build procurement strategies that are aligned with broader business and functional objectives.


Category Management & Strategic Sourcing

  • Develop and execute comprehensive category strategies across key indirect spend areas such as IT, Marketing, Professional Services, HR, Facilities, and other corporate services.
  • Lead complex, high-value sourcing initiatives from opportunity identification and market analysis through to sourcing, negotiation, contracting, implementation, and benefits realization.
  • Develop category roadmaps that identify opportunities for cost savings, cost avoidance, value creation, supplier optimization, risk mitigation, and process improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional sourcing teams, bringing together business stakeholders, Finance, Legal, and other relevant functions to deliver strategic outcomes.
  • Establish a strong understanding of supplier markets, emerging trends, cost drivers, and competitive dynamics to inform category strategies and sourcing decisions.
  • Ensure sourcing and category initiatives deliver sustainable results that are tracked, measured, and communicated to stakeholders.


Data, AI & Procurement Transformation

  • Leverage procurement data, analytics, and enterprise AI capabilities to identify opportunities, improve decision-making, and increase procurement effectiveness.
  • Use data storytelling to translate complex spend, supplier, and market information into clear, compelling recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and transform procurement processes through technology, AI, and innovative ways of working.
  • Establish fact-based business cases that demonstrate the financial and strategic impact of procurement initiatives.
  • Contribute to the continued evolution of the Indirect Procurement function, helping establish scalable, data-driven, and digitally enabled ways of working.


Commercial Value & Supplier Management

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, ensuring procurement strategies deliver competitive pricing, favorable contractual terms, and broader business value.
  • Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships, balancing performance, innovation, commercial value, resilience, and risk.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate spend, improve supplier performance, optimize commercial models, and unlock additional value.
  • Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to ensure savings and other procurement benefits are accurately measured, validated, and sustained.
  • Monitor category and supplier performance, proactively addressing risks and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.


Leadership & Procurement Excellence

  • Lead through influence, bringing structure, pace, and accountability to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Mentor and support procurement colleagues, sharing category expertise, commercial best practices, and strategic sourcing capabilities.
  • Represent Indirect Procurement as a strategic business function, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and value creation.
  • Contribute to procurement-wide initiatives and transformation programs beyond individual category responsibilities.

As part of the planned separation, DePuy Ireland UC will assume Orthopaedics distribution activities from Johnson & Johnson’s MedTech business. These span distribution centres across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), serving group companies and customers worldwide.

DePuy Synthes, a business of approximately $9 billion, is seeking a Senior Finance Manager within Supply Chain Finance to lead finance for these substantial added activities, combining financial leadership, business partnering and transformation delivery.

Your primary focus will be establishing the finance capabilities, resources and processes needed for these activities ahead of the April 2027 go-live.

  • Establish scalable, standardised finance processes using analytics and automation tools such as Alteryx, Power BI and Tableau.

DePuy Synthes, a ~$9 billion business, has an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Finance Manager operating within Supply Chain Finance to gain extensive exposure across DePuy Synthes Principal Operations while leading the Currency Management team.

Role Overview

In this role, you will provide financial leadership to the Currency Management team, leading the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, centralized hedging, hedge and inventory accounting, forecasting, analytics and reporting across DePuy Synthes.

You will play a critical role in standing up the group to operate as a standalone DePuy Synthes Principal Operations team, ensuring that essential currency management activities continue to be performed to the highest standards of compliance, accuracy and insight before, during and after separation.

The immediate focus of the role will be to stand up the Currency Management team and its operating model; establish the end-to-end exposure identification, hedge submission, accounting and control processes required to support placement of hedges through a third-party provider; and lead the development and ongoing maintenance of replacement calculation and analytics capabilities as existing systems will not be available to DePuy Synthes following separation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop a global team of three finance professionals.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for currency-related topics and questions across DePuy Synthes.
  • Lead the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, including centralized forecasting and balance sheet hedging, and establish the process required to place hedges with a third-party provider.
  • Ensure accurate and compliant hedge and inventory accounting in line with US GAAP and relevant accounting procedures.
  • Lead the calculation, analysis, reporting and communication of actual and forecast transactional currency impacts across DePuy Synthes P&L lines, including driver-based variance analysis, trends, risks and opportunities.
  • Provide currency analytics, insights and recommendations to DSPO, FP&A, Treasury and senior management.
  • Lead regular currency and hedge-result reviews with business partners and senior leadership and provide training and educational materials to strengthen understanding of currency and hedging principles across DePuy Synthes.
  • Lead the design, build, testing and deployment of a replacement tool to support currency calculations, hedging, analytics and reporting, and oversee its ongoing maintenance and enhancement.
  • Drive standardized and efficient processes through automation and analytics tools, including Power BI and Alteryx.

Job Description:

 

DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Sr. Manager, EMEA - SC Technology Logistics

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopedics business to establish a standalone orthopedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.


Job Overview

The Senior Manager, EMEA Supply Chain Technology - Logistics is the accountable technology leader for the DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver domain. The role owns the regional Deliver technology roadmap and ensures that logistics technology capabilities are reliable, secure, compliant, scalable and aligned with DePuy Synthes business priorities, EMEA operational needs and global Supply Chain Technology strategies.

The role partners with regional and global Supply Chain, Deliver, Technology, Digital, Architecture, Finance, Quality, Procurement and external logistics providers to translate business strategy into an integrated portfolio of technology investments, operational improvements and transformation outcomes. The Senior Manager balances transformation delivery with uninterrupted business operations and clear accountability for value realisation.

 

Leadership Profile

A seasoned, strategic and pragmatic technology leader who combines business partnership with technical judgement, operational discipline and delivery accountability. The successful candidate is comfortable making trade-offs, creating clarity across organisational boundaries, developing talent and ensuring that transformation produces sustainable, measurable value without compromising service, compliance or continuity.

 

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Roadmap Ownership

·        Own and maintain the multi-year DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver technology roadmap, aligned to the business strategy, network evolution, operational priorities and global technology direction.

·        Translate business capabilities and pain points into a prioritised, sequenced and funded portfolio with clear dependencies, decision points, risks and measurable outcomes.

·        Provide strategic direction across core logistics platforms, warehouse automation, data, integration and emerging digital capabilities.


Regional, Business Unit and Global Accountability

·        Serve as the primary technology partner for DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver, with clear accountability for regional outcomes while operating within global product, platform, architecture, cybersecurity and compliance governance.

·        Clarify decision rights, ownership and handoffs across the regional business, DePuy Synthes, global Deliver, ERP and platform teams, and shared technology functions.

·        Represent EMEA priorities in global forums and ensure that global standards and roadmaps are adopted appropriately, with regional requirements and trade-offs made transparent.


Technology Ecosystem and Architecture

·        Provide end-to-end oversight of the EMEA Deliver technology ecosystem, including ERP, WMS, WCS/WES, TMS, warehouse automation, transportation, labelling, visibility, data and analytics, and internal and external integrations.

·        Partner with enterprise and solution architects to define target-state architecture, reduce fragmentation and technical debt, and ensure secure, scalable and supportable integration patterns.

ashby:lemfi:04c84e70-b89e-4467-9c66-a33f.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the…
ashby:lemfi:04c84e70-b89e-4467-9c66-a33f.full_description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.




ABOUT THE ROLE

LemFi moves over $2B a month across 30+ countries for people who have built lives far from where they started. That makes us a target, in some of the most scrutinised payment corridors in the world, and attackers often go after the people and devices behind the product rather than the product itself. Here, security is an engineering problem first.
We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer in Dublin to own how we protect LemFi from the inside: every laptop, account, inbox and internal tool our teams rely on. You'll report directly to our CTO, build the controls, write the detections and run the incident when something gets through. It's a small team, so you'll write the playbook rather than follow one. There's compliance work at LemFi, but this seat is about stopping attackers and building controls, not running audits.




WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Endpoint protection across all laptops and devices: EDR, device management, hardening and patching, configured so a compromised device is caught fast and contained faster.

 - Identity and access across the company: SSO, MFA, privileged access, joiner and leaver flows, and access reviews that actually remove access.

 - Email, collaboration and SaaS security, including phishing defence and visibility into the internal tools our teams use every day.

 - Detection engineering and threat hunting across endpoint, identity and internal systems. Write the detections, tune out the noise, and hunt for what they miss.

 - Incident response from first alert through forensics and root cause to the change that closes the gap for good.

 - Threat intelligence on the actors targeting fintech employees and our corridors, turned into detections and controls rather than reports.

 - Automation that removes manual work from triage, response and access management, using AI and ML wherever they make detection sharper.




YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - At least 5 years of hands-on security work across incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence or security engineering, with recent work you built and shipped yourself.

 - Hands-on experience running endpoint protection or EDR at scale across Windows and macOS.

 - Strong identity and access management experience with directories, SSO and MFA, such as Entra ID, Okta or Google Workspace.

 - Led real incidents end to end, including forensic investigation on endpoints.

 - Written detections in a SIEM that caught real activity, and kept false positive rates down.

 - Write Python or Go well enough to build your own tooling and automate your own work.

 - Practical use of AI or ML in security work: you can show where it helped, and you validate its output rather than trust it blindly.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in banking, payments or another regulated financial environment, or rolling out EDR, MDM or email security from scratch.

 - Network security experience (firewalls, VPN, zero trust) or cloud security in AWS, particularly workforce access and logging.

 - Purple team exercises mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, or knowledge of the threat landscape in African, LATAM or Asian payments markets.



WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities. 




RECRUITMENT AGENCIES NOTICE

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.




AI IN HIRING AT LEMFI

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy https://www.lemfi.com/en-gb/legal/candidate-ai-use to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

ashby:n8n:49e569f0-503e-4e42-a1ba-7e6368.full_description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to identify and reduce security risks across n8n's product and internal systems, using threat modelling, hands-on security expertise, and cross-functional collaboration to help teams design, build, and operate more secure systems.

You'll join our growing security team at a pivotal stage, acting as a trusted security partner to teams across the business. You'll help us build a move from reactive security management to a proactive, scalable security practice.

Here's what you'll be driving:


THREAT MODELLING, RISK ASSESSMENT & SECURITY DESIGN

 - Conduct threat modelling and risk assessments across product features, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, corporate IT, internal applications, and data systems, identifying vulnerabilities and recommending practical mitigations.

 - Partner with Engineering, Cloud, IT, and Data teams to review security designs, define actionable security requirements, and influence the implementation of appropriate controls.

 - Help teams embed security into their development processes through secure coding guidance, design reviews, documentation, and security tooling that enables them to identify and address risks independently.


VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT & COORDINATED DISCLOSURE

 - Participate in the security triage rotation, assessing incoming vulnerability reports, validating findings, and prioritising remediation based on severity and business impact.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams to coordinate vulnerability remediation, verify fixes, and support secure patch and release processes.

 - Help manage our vulnerability disclosure and bug bounty programmes, including engagement with security researchers, coordinated disclosures, and GitHub Security Advisories.


SECURITY OPERATIONS & INCIDENT READINESS

 - Help establish and improve logging, detection, and protective monitoring capabilities across our infrastructure, corporate systems, and internal applications.

 - Develop and improve incident response processes, runbooks, and exercises to strengthen our ability to detect, investigate, and respond to security incidents.

 - Work closely with system owners to identify security gaps, prioritise remediation, and verify that implemented controls effectively reduce risk.


CUSTOMER TRUST & COMPLIANCE ENGINEERING

 - Support SOC 2 compliance by helping establish continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, and processes that make security assurance part of everyday operations.

 - Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to respond to customer security assessments and build reusable resources that streamline future requests.

 - Partner with Legal, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to assess security risks, improve security policies and controls, and strengthen trust with enterprise customers.

We're hiring two Security Engineers with complementary strengths, so you don't need to be an expert in every security domain. 


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🔍 Threat Modelling & Risk Assessment: You have hands-on experience assessing real-world systems, identifying security risks, determining defensible severity levels, and recommending practical controls that teams can implement.

 - 🛠️ Technical Security Expertise: You can validate security findings, reproduce vulnerabilities, develop proof-of-concepts, and write code or automation when needed to demonstrate risks or improve security processes.

 - 🔐 Security Engineering Experience: You've worked hands-on in infrastructure, product, or application security within a product-focused organisation, with a strong understanding of how modern systems are designed and secured.

 - 🤝 Cross-functional Influence: You're comfortable acting as an internal security consultant, advising teams, challenging technical decisions constructively, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

 - 🎯 Risk Remediation & Ownership: You've helped secure systems you don't directly own, translating security findings into actionable requirements and working with responsible teams to ensure effective remediation.

 - 🤖 AI & LLM Fluency: You're comfortable using LLM-assisted tooling and understand its limitations, security implications, and potential failure modes.

 - ✍️ Clear Communication: You can explain complex security risks, document technical findings, and provide practical guidance that engineers and non-technical stakeholders can confidently act on.

ashby:crusoe:2b51201b-1830-4c3e-89ec-146.full_description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

Crusoe Cloud is revolutionizing high-performance computing by offering sustainable, low-cost GPU compute power. As a Cloud Support Engineer, you'll play a crucial role in empowering our customers to leverage this technology for groundbreaking advancements in fields like AI/ML, physics simulations, and computational biology. You will be the primary point of contact for technical support, ensuring our customers can seamlessly utilize Crusoe Cloud to achieve their goals. This role directly impacts Crusoe's mission by enabling our customers to accelerate their research and development, contributing to a more sustainable future. You will be involved in exciting projects, working with cutting-edge technologies and collaborating with a talented team to solve complex challenges. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated and experienced technical professional with a passion for customer success, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a commitment to Crusoe's values. This is a full-time position.

What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Customer Support: Provide exceptional technical support to customers via Zendesk, meeting SLAs and maintaining high CSAT (95%+).

 - On-Call Rotation: Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to ensure timely resolution of critical issues.

 - Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve issues related to VMs, hardware failures, and scaling tests using CLI and internal tools.

 - Alert Triage and Maintenance: Manage alert triage, prepare for maintenance windows, and conduct node delivery testing.

 - Collaboration: Work closely with SRE, Networking, and Storage teams from initial triage to root cause analysis (RCA) delivery.

 - Global Teamwork: Adhere to global team collaboration and handoff processes for ticketing and on-call procedures.

 - Knowledge Sharing: Develop onboarding/training materials, knowledge base documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or 4+ years of equivalent technical experience.

 - Linux Proficiency: Strong command-line interface (CLI) skills in Linux environments.

 - Version Control: Proficiency with Git for code management and collaboration.

 - Customer Support Experience: 5+ years of experience in a customer support role, ideally within cloud, storage, or networking environments.

 - Cloud Technologies: Experience with container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), workload management (e.g., Slurm, Terraform), and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana).

 - Public Cloud Knowledge: Familiarity with other public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

 - Communication Skills: Excellent communication and customer service skills, including the ability to prioritize competing escalations.

 - HPC Knowledge: Understanding of HPC technologies such as Infiniband, RDMA, RoCE, and Software Defined Networking (SDN).

Bonus Points:

 - Certifications: CKA, CKAD, CKS, KCNA, AWS Machine Learning - Specialty, Data Analytics - Specialty, Solutions Architect - Professional, Developer - Associate, NVIDIA AI Infrastructure and Operations, Generative AI and LLMs, Generative AI Multi-modal, Infiniband, Linux Foundation IT Associate, System Administrator.

 - Cloud Expertise: Deep understanding of specific cloud platforms and services.

 - Automation Skills: Experience with automation tools and scripting languages.

 - Problem-Solving Abilities: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions.

 - Collaboration and Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor, train, and onboard colleagues.

 - Passion for Sustainability: A strong interest in contributing to a more sustainable future through technology.

Benefits:

Crusoe also offers a competitive benefits package designed to support financial security, health, and overall well-being, including pension contributions, private health and dental insurance, income protection, life assurance and more.

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid as salary or hourly. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

We are seeking a Hardware Production / Sustaining Engineer to strengthen Crusoe’s Hardware Systems Engineering team and close critical skill gaps in debugging, validation, and production support of high-performance compute systems. In this role, you will take ownership of the full hardware lifecycle—from prototype bring-up to large-scale production—while driving automation, deep issue resolution, and reliability across Crusoe Cloud’s GPU- and CPU-based infrastructure.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to support, debug, and improve hardware platforms at scale, with a particular focus on PCIe, InfiniBand, and NVMe/storage, which have been identified as essential areas for deeper expertise. Your work will directly impact Crusoe’s ability to deploy and operate sustainable, AI-first compute systems with world-class performance and reliability.

 

What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Drive the full hardware development and sustaining lifecycle, including feasibility, bring-up, validation, deployment, and ongoing production support.

 - Develop and maintain scripting and automation frameworks for hardware testing, diagnostics, and continuous reliability improvements.

 - Lead deep troubleshooting and debugging across:
   
   - PCIe (link training, topology, performance issues)
   
   - InfiniBand (fabric debugging, throughput, connectivity issues)
   
   - NVMe/storage (performance bottlenecks, firmware interactions, failure analysis)

 - Conduct rigorous system validation and characterization for GPU, CPU, and high-performance compute platforms.

 - Support E2E integration and solution testing to ensure Crusoe Cloud products meet performance, reliability, and scalability expectations.

 - Collaborate with mechanical, thermal, firmware, software, and manufacturing teams to resolve system-level issues and enable stable production operation.

 - Drive prototyping, qualification, and readiness for high-volume manufacturing with both internal teams and external vendors.

 - Identify opportunities for new hardware technologies, testing methods, and sustainability improvements aligned with Crusoe’s long-term objectives.

 - Provide data-driven insights to influence Crusoe’s hardware roadmap and reliability strategy.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - 4-8 years of experience in hardware development, validation, sustaining engineering, or production engineering.

 - Strong hands-on expertise in PCIe, InfiniBand, and NVMe/storage debugging and development.

 - Deep proficiency in hardware bring-up, board-level debugging, and system-level validation.

 - Ability to design and implement automation frameworks for hardware testing (Python, Shell, or similar).

 - Technical background in digital and analog design, server architecture, and high-performance compute hardware.

 - Experience working across thermal, mechanical, firmware, and software functions in multidisciplinary environments.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with internal teams and external partners.

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.

 

Bonus Points:

 - Experience designing or optimizing GPU-to-GPU communication architectures for AI/ML workloads.

 - Direct experience integrating NVLink or other next-generation GPU interconnect technologies.

 - Familiarity with cutting-edge GPU architectures and how to leverage them in AI/HPC environments.

 - Expertise supporting or designing systems across both ARM and x86 server architectures.

 - Background in sustainable or energy-efficient hardware design practices.

 - Advanced certifications or coursework in AI/HPC hardware systems.



Benefits:

Crusoe offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support well-being and financial security. This includes full social security coverage, contributions to provident, trade union, and pension funds, with options for additional pensions. Employees also have optional access to Global Life Insurance and private health insurance. Crusoe provides generous leave policies, including maternity, paternity, parental, and sick leave, ensuring you have the support you need at every stage of life.

 

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid as salary or hourly. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

workday:logitech:148515.full_description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location: Cork

Working Model: 3 days / week in the office


The Role:

Are you a skilled technical professional interested in joining a paid-for Services program with high opportunities?  We are searching for a Senior Customer Support Engineer in Cork who will be responsible for troubleshooting and finding solutions to difficult technical problems.  The role will focus mainly on Logitech’s Paid Services support for video conferencing solutions but may occasionally be asked to resolve issues with other enterprise Software (MS, Zoom, Google). Expect to communicate with customers via Phone, email or video calls, and provide high touch service across global organizations, partnering with ITDMs to maintain their valuable conference room spaces or help them as they deploy.  At Logitech, you will assist customers with issues that ensure that the Enterprise customer’s meeting rooms stay running and quickly help to find a root cause for an issue within the ecosystem. You will also enjoy opportunities to advance your Career in a diverse environment.


Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble, Collaborate and Challenge. Have a great attitude and enjoy helping customers in a timely, efficient and pleasant way. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:


  • Resolve technically complex support issues reported by the customers and/or other team members. 
  • Maintain clear, concise and positive communication for all cases in a timely and efficient manner including proactive follow up with customers, team members and product engineers.
  • Own the technical relationship with customers and manage their expectations.
  • Work with department leadership and other stakeholders to address bugs, technical issues, compatibility, and other issues that can’t be resolved with standard troubleshooting
  • Provide ad hoc feedback about trends and new issues
  • Occasionally, as necessary, answer non-escalated phone calls and email support tickets to ensure department service levels agreements are met.
  • Provide ideas and assist with creation of knowledge base documentation and training materials for both internal and external customers.
  • Deliver consistent customer experience that meets or exceeds our commitments.
  • Be compassionate, respectful and honest 

Key Qualifications:

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:


  • Expert knowledge of video conferencing and AV products
  • Expert/Advance knowledge of windows and Mac OS  
  • Excellent working knowledge of video conferencing applications such as Zoom, MS Teams and Google Meet
  • Advanced knowledge of computer networking and operating systems
  • Familiarity with Android-based device (beyond cellular phones) desirable
  • Familiarity with IOS devices desirable
  • Excellent communications both verbal, oral and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent customer service skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new technologies 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle extremely complex technical issues, including working with engineers when necessary.
  • Good working knowledge and skills in MS office 365, Exchange, Azure AD and SSO.  
  • Professional level English,  spoken and written.   

In addition, preferable skills and behaviors include:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a technical support capacity, with at least 2 years videoconference (VC) troubleshooting experience
  • Minimum 2 years of providing remote technical support
  • 1yr providing high-touch support to Enterprise accounts

The Role

In this role on the Privileged Access Management team, your primary responsibility will be to own and operate Fidelity’s HashiCorp Vault application. This is an enterprise-class installation providing secrets management services to over 5,000 business unit applications. You will design, develop, and support new and improved access management capabilities that meet Fidelity’s stringent cybersecurity policies and requirements. You will administer critical production environments including implementation of monitoring, upgrades, performance & capacity improvements, certifying disaster readiness, improving CI/CD with process automation, and analyzing key metrics and trends. We operate in an Agile framework where you will have an opportunity to participate in sprint planning to provide prioritization, and realistic and achievable estimates. You will also contribute towards continuous improvement efforts aimed at increasing the efficiency and velocity of the team.

 

 The Expertise and Skills You Bring

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Systems Networking, Information Systems/Science, or a related discipline
    • 5+ years of experience and demonstrated expertise with administration and operation of the HashiCorp Vault application is a requirement for this role
    • You have systems and application management experience on Linux/UNIX platforms
    • You have experience with cloud architecture and have built applications in, or migrated applications to, Amazon Web Services AWS or Microsoft Azure
    • You have experience with networking, firewalls, and load balancers
    • You have experience building automated pipelines and deploying with CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, Git, Ansible, Chef, Artifactory, AWS Cloud Formation Templates, Terraform, EC2, Lambda, Docker/Kubernetes, and KMS
    • You develop advanced, customized workflows and automated processes for/with vendor applications
    • You have strong scripting & automation skills, specifically in Python and Ansible
    • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to both technical and business audiences
    • You have demonstrated experience in leading small technical teams
    • You have the ability to independently perform systems design & architecture work to satisfy technical objectives and meet business requirements

 

The Team

In this position you will join Fidelity’s Enterprise Cybersecurity business unit as a member of the Privileged Access Management team. We are a dynamic, high visibility team that provides a variety of access management services to all of Fidelity’s business units. The Privileged Access Management team is comprised of engineers located in the US, Ireland, and India. We leverage an Agile operating model to install, configure, operate, and maintain a set of in-house and vendor applications providing a multitude of access management capabilities to the firm. We are a DevOps team that engages in systems engineering, software engineering, and production services support.

Job Description:

Senior Incident Responder - Security Operations Center


The Opportunity

Fidelity's Security Operations Center is looking for a Senior Incident Responder to join the team investigating and containing threats against our global environment. This is a high-impact individual contributor role where your analysis and decisions directly reduce risk for Fidelity, its affiliates, partners, and millions of customers.


You won't just close tickets. You'll work investigations end to end, contribute to containment and eradication, and turn every incident into lasting improvements in our detection and response capability. If you thrive under pressure and are relentless about finding the truth in the data, this role was built for you.


What You'll Do

Respond to Incidents

  • Investigate security incidents from detection through containment, eradication, and recovery
  • Work escalated and high-severity events alongside infrastructure, application, legal, and business teams
  • Conduct network, host, cloud, and identity-based forensic analysis to scope compromise and identify indicators
  • Perform malware triage and analysis to determine capability, persistence, and impact
  • Produce clear, defensible incident documentation, timelines, and post-incident reports for technical and executive audiences

Drive Detection & Hunting

  • Develop and refine threat detection content informed by attacker TTPs (MITRE ATT&CK)
  • Participate in threat hunting initiatives that uncover gaps in visibility and coverage
  • Feed lessons learned from investigations back into detections, runbooks, and automation
  • Support alert triage during surge periods and share investigative technique with junior analysts

Shape Strategy

  • Contribute to SOC leadership strategy, roadmap planning, and capability development
  • Help build and exercise incident response playbooks, tabletop scenarios, and escalation paths
  • Identify opportunities to apply automation and AI/LLM technologies to investigative workflows
  • Champion continuous improvement across tools, processes, and team capabilities

What You Bring

Required

  • Established cybersecurity background. You understand the threat landscape, common attack vectors, and defensive operations without needing to be taught the fundamentals
  • 3+ years in Information Security incident response, digital forensics, or SOC investigations
  • Demonstrated experience investigating real intrusions, not just alert queue triage
  • Deep familiarity with SIEM, SOAR, and EDR tooling in an enterprise environment
  • Strong host-based forensics skills across Windows and Linux (file system, memory, registry, event log, and artifact analysis)
  • Solid understanding of network protocols, network traffic analysis, and attacker tradecraft
  • Experience investigating incidents in cloud environments (Azure, AWS) and identity platforms (Entra ID / Active Directory)
  • Working proficiency in a scripting language such as Python for data parsing, enrichment, and analysis at scale
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey findings clearly during an active incident

Preferred

  • Malware reverse engineering or advanced memory forensics experience
  • Experience investigating containerized and Kubernetes workloads
  • Experience applying LLMs or AI to security operations workflows (triage assistance, enrichment, content generation)
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence tradecraft and adversary attribution
  • Experience with eDiscovery, legal hold, or regulatory breach notification processes
  • Detection engineering experience in a modern SIEM query language
  • Industry certifications: GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GREM, OSCP, CISSP, or equivalent

Who Thrives Here

  • You stay calm and methodical when the stakes are high and the picture is incomplete
  • You are genuinely eager to learn new too

ashby:openai:7d10d614-dc7c-427f-abc1-9a4.full_description:
About the Team

The EMEA Growth Marketing role partners with regional leadership, central Marketing functions and Product Growth to help more people discover ChatGPT, find value and keep coming back. We combine local market insight, paid marketing and creative experimentation to build campaigns that resonate across EMEA’s diverse audiences. Our approach is hands-on and data-driven, with a focus on testing, learning and scaling what delivers meaningful growth and lasting value for users.

About the Role

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Lead, EMEA to help more people discover ChatGPT, find value and keep coming back. You will own paid marketing across all of our key performance channels and support in our broader full-funnel media buying endeavors.

You bring deep paid-marketing experience, credible EMEA knowledge and the range to build a broader marketing function in-time. The role begins as a senior individual contributor, though we expect with the pace of growth you will quickly need to build a team. We are a team of ‘doers’ and everyone starts out this way at Open AI.

In this role, you will:

 - Prioritise EMEA markets and stay close to campaign setup, channel performance, creative testing and paid-media investment decisions.

 - Help develop local creative briefs and creator inputs for paid growth, with an eye towards brand-building performance.

 - Connect marketing activity to incremental weekly active users (iWAU) and incremental annual recurring revenue (iARR), with targets aligned with Finance and relevant Growth owners.

 - Work with regional and central partners on delivery handoffs and shared services.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have personally owned large paid-media budgets and campaign decisions, and driven measurable growth in a fast-moving consumer technology or comparable product-led environment.

 - Bring meaningful EMEA market knowledge, hands-on operating depth, sound incrementality judgment and the ability to prioritise and execute without a large team.

 - Want to start as a senior individual contributor and build towards broader regional marketing ownership.

ashby:lemfi:18697ce4-74a6-47aa-bcad-2e5a.full_description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.




ABOUT THE ROLE


 As Senior Technical Accountant, reporting to the Head of Financial Control and Reporting, you will be LemFi's go-to authority on how we account for what we do. You will own the Group accounting policy manual, write the technical papers on every key judgement area, get ahead of new products before they launch, and be the main contact for auditors on complex technical questions. 

You will partner closely with Global Finance Operations and Reconciliation and Strategic Finance, ensuring that US GAAP consolidated accounts and local entity statutory accounts are accurate from revenue recognition to balance sheet classification. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys hard accounting questions and explains the answers clearly. The role is based in London or Dublin, with dedicated time in either hub.




WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Own the Group accounting policy manual across US GAAP, FRS 102 and local frameworks, keeping it current as standards and the business evolve.

 - Write clear, defensible technical papers covering key judgement areas: revenue recognition on fees and FX, credit losses (CECL and IFRS 9), safeguarded customer funds and share-based payments.

 - Get ahead of new products - assess accounting treatment for new products, markets, partnerships and funding facilities before launch, working with Product, Legal, Tax and Treasury.

 - Lead on technical audit areas: be the auditors' main contact on judgement areas, close out findings related to accounting treatment, and ensure no material audit adjustments in your areas.

 - Set the rules for transaction accounting - define how fees, FX, chargebacks, settlements and processor flows are recorded, and work with Finance Transformation to build those rules into NetSuite posting logic and automated controls.

 - Bridge the frameworks: maintain the US GAAP to statutory reconciliation, support the consolidation with the Financial Reporting and Consolidation Manager, and keep intercompany recharges consistent across the Group.

 - Run a prioritised technical accounting log, reviewed monthly with the Financial Control and Finance Operations leads, so nothing falls through the cracks.




YOUR EXPERIENCE

 - ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent qualification, with 7 or more years of post-qualification experience.

 - A background in Big 4 (or similar) audit, ideally in financial services, or in a technical accounting team in-house.

 - Direct experience in a remittance, payments, e-money or similarly regulated financial services business - as an auditor or in-house.

 - Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP, and solid working knowledge of FRS 102 or IFRS.

 - Experience with credit loss accounting under CECL or IFRS 9.

 - Clear, concise technical writing and the confidence to defend a position with auditors and senior stakeholders.

 - A hands-on approach: as comfortable posting a complex journal as writing the policy paper that justifies it.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in US GAAP consolidation for a multi-entity international group.

 - Experience designing accounting rules for ERP or automation projects, ideally in NetSuite.

 - Exposure to share-based payments, debt facilities or equity fundraising accounting.



WHY JOIN LEMFI?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/lemfi/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/uselemfi/ and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lemfi/id1533066809 or Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en&id=com.lemonadeFinance.android. 


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/lemfi/form/talent-community to stay in touch for future opportunities. 




RECRUITMENT AGENCIES NOTICE

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.




AI IN HIRING AT LEMFI

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy https://www.lemfi.com/en-gb/legal/candidate-ai-use to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

ashby:seccl:5065ded2-fd9f-4f9b-a523-ccc4.full_description:
Hybrid role based in our Dublin office, with occasional travel to our UK offices as needed



About us
Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.



We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland.



We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.



We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.



If you want to help build the next chapter of Seccl in Ireland and shape the future of investing across Europe, you’ll be in good company.



Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.



The role
As Head of finance for Seccl Ireland, you'll own our financial reporting, capital position and financial controls. You'll make sure the numbers are right, the capital is there, and that our board and the Central Bank of Ireland can rely on both.



This is a Pre-Approval Controlled Function (PCF-11) under the Central Bank's Fitness and Probity regime. You'll be the named individual accountable for finance at Seccl Ireland, reporting on those matters to the Seccl Ireland Board. You can be a previous PCF holder, or a first-time PCF holder who is ready to take a step up to take on that responsibility.



You'll join as one of our early Dublin hires, supporting authorisation and building the finance function as we grow. That means setting up the processes, controls and reporting rhythm of a regulated business from the start, while working closely with finance colleagues in the UK. You'll be as comfortable presenting to the board as you are getting into the detail of a reconciliation.



What you’ll own

 - Owning Seccl Ireland’s statutory accounts, management accounts and board financial reporting, so they’re accurate, timely and audit-ready

 - Leading the annual external audit, from the timetable and evidence requests through to responding to findings

 - Owning the regulatory reporting calendar and monitoring capital, own funds and liquidity, so the board always has a clear view of our position

 - Acting as the key point of contact for the Central Bank on finance and regulatory matters, supporting our authorisation and ongoing supervisory relationship

 - Building the financial controls, policies and processes for a regulated business from scratch, using automation where it makes sense

 - Leading budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling with the Irish leadership team, and recommending the annual plan to the board

 - Giving our Ireland CEO and leadership team clear, commercially minded financial insight that shapes decisions early
   
   

This role’s for you if...

 - You have significant finance experience in a regulated Irish financial services business

 - You hold a professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent) and membership of a recognised professional body

 - You understand the prudential requirements for investment firms in Ireland, including capital, own funds and liquidity

 - You have a strong technical grounding in financial reporting, statutory accounts and audit under IFRS or FRS 102

 - You’re confident presenting to boards and audit committees, and engaging directly with auditors and regulators

 - You’re hands-on and self-sufficient, comfortable building processes from scratch and flexing across the group

 - Desirable: you’ve worked with finance systems and automation, and want to replace manual, spreadsheet-heavy processes
   
   

This role isn’t for you if...

 - You prefer a defined remit. Breadth is the point here: you’ll move between reporting, audit, regulatory returns, planning and ad hoc group projects

 - You rely on top-down direction. You’ll be very self-sufficient, setting your own priorities as the function takes shape

 - You’d rather stay out of the detail. This role is hands-on, so you’ll need to get into reconciliations, reporting and audit evidence as well as setting strategy

 - You’re not comfortable being personally accountable to the Central Bank. As the named individual for finance, you’ll need to stand behind the numbers and the regulatory relationship


What’s in it for you
We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

 - 💰 A salary between €100,000-€125,000 dependant on experience, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution

 - 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

 - 💙 Two volunteering days each year

 - 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

 - 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

 - 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

 - 🏥 Private medical insurance

 - 👪 Enhanced parental leave

 - 💻 MacBook and up to €500 towards your home office set-up

 - 📖 Annual learning budget

 - 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

 - 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

ashby:Vanta:ecdf2c04-47a5-4360-a664-4341.full_description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



We are seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.



Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.



What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta:

 - Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts

 - Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

 - Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

 - Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

 - Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

 - Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

 - Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment

 - Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region



How to be successful in this role:

 - Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

 - Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

 - Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

 - Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

 - Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

 - Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

 - Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

 - Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

 - Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

 - Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.



This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the Dublin office.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

 - Pension matching

 - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

 - 8 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

ashby:netgear:6378f870-27e1-4b76-a55c-37.full_description:
Role Overview

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation to be on site at least 2 days per week in our Cork office.



This role sits at the intersection of people operations and total rewards, with global scope and genuine ownership. You will manage the systems, processes, and programmes that underpin how we attract, retain, and reward our people worldwide bringing operational rigour and strategic thinking in equal measure.

You will work closely with HR leadership, Finance, and Legal, acting as a trusted partner to HRBPs and business leaders globally. You will play a central role in driving the AI-enabled transformation of the People function - identifying opportunities to automate workflows, augment decision-making, and redesign how the team operates day to day using emerging AI tools and capabilities.



Responsibilities

People Operations

 - Lead the AI transformation of People Operations evaluating, piloting, and embedding AI tools across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and policy management to compensation modelling and people analytics, and building the team's capability to work effectively alongside AI.

 - Own and continuously improve global HR operations including HRIS (UKG) administration, data integrity, process documentation, and AI-enabled workflow automation - ensuring a seamless employee experience at every stage of the lifecycle.

 - Manage and evolve HR policies globally, ensuring compliance with local employment law across multiple jurisdictions while maintaining consistency in global people practices. 

 - Build and maintain people analytics reporting to support data-driven decisions by HR leadership and business partners.

 - Own the People team's technology stack, working closely with IT and Data teams to integrate systems, safeguard data, and unlock new capabilities.

 - Manage and develop a small global team, setting priorities and building capability across time zones.  



Total Rewards

 - Lead the design, administration, and communication of global compensation programmes - including salary structures, bonus plans, and equity ensuring they are competitive, equitable, and aligned to business strategy.

 - Own and evolve the benefits portfolio with responsibility for managing vendor relationships, renewals, and regional programme design. As the company continues to grow, this role will play a key part in extending our benefits offering into additional regions ensuring local market norms and regulatory requirements are met at every stage.

 - Drive the annual compensation review cycle end-to-end, from market benchmarking and budget modelling to manager guidance and employee communications.

 - Conduct and interpret compensation benchmarking surveys (Radford) to keep pay ranges current and defensible, and advise on offer competitiveness and internal equity.

 - Lead pay equity analysis and gender pay gap reporting.



Required Qualifications

 - 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with meaningful depth in both people operations and compensation and/or benefits.

 - Proficiency with HRIS platforms (UKG, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent) and strong analytical skills - comfortable building models and presenting data-driven recommendations.

 - Total compensation design and strategy experience, including salary structures, bonus plans, equity (RSUs, stock options), and benefits with the ability to architect, communicate, and govern total reward frameworks in a global, multi-jurisdiction environment.

 - Technology or hardware industry is preferred, with familiarity with the compensation structures, equity programmes, and talent dynamics typical of a global tech environment.

 - Experience applying AI tools to HR processes whether through workflow automation, predictive analytics, or process redesign with a practical, hands-on approach to identifying and implementing new capabilities.

 - Understanding of global employment law, including Irish employment legislation, GDPR, and the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

 - Experience managing global benefits programmes across multiple countries and vendors, with an understanding of regional market norms.

 - Clear, confident communication - able to translate complex compensation mechanics into plain language for managers and employees, and present recommendations credibly to senior stakeholders.

 - Strong project management skills - able to lead programmes from design to delivery, manage multiple workstreams, and follow through consistently.

 - Collaborative and inclusive working style - effective across time zones, able to build trust with distributed teams.

 - Proven experience managing and developing a small team, with the ability to set direction, coach individuals, and drive performance in a global environment.
   
   

Preferred Qualifications

 - A third-level qualification in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field is desirable, though equivalent professional experience and/or CIPD qualification will be equally considered.

 - Experience in a US-headquartered company.

Eligibility to live and work in Ireland is required. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
