You will operate as an AI-first functional lead rather than a traditional editorial manager. There are no direct reports, deliberately. Your leverage will come from the AI systems and governance you design—research agents, brand-voice models, fact-checking, source verification, repurposing, and evaluation—plus the senior stakeholders, freelancers, agencies, and subject-matter experts you mobilize.

We are looking for the person who wants to find out how much editorial ambition one exceptional operator with a well-built AI stack can carry, and who will set the standard for what an AI-native content function looks like. The scope is unusual for a single role: a live audience across our library, newsletter, and podcast; a leadership team that publishes and speaks; proprietary employment data from 180+ countries; and the mandate to build this function the way it should be built, not the way it has always been done.

Own the narrative

 - Define Oyster’s long-term editorial and category strategy across Marketing, executive leadership, Product, People, Legal, and customer-facing teams.

 - Resolve high-stakes narrative trade-offs and establish the positions, evidence standards, and language Oyster uses consistently across business areas.

 - Own a multi-year editorial roadmap and a focused portfolio of flagship research and thought-leadership bets linked to company strategy.

 - Act as the final quality bar for voice, accuracy, evidence, and taste across human- and AI-produced content.



Build company-wide AI content mechanisms

 - Architect and govern reusable systems for research, brand voice, fact-checking, source verification, repurposing, evaluation, and reporting.

 - Define risk-based rules for where AI leads, where humans lead, and where specialist or executive approval is mandatory.

 - Establish mechanisms and standards adopted across Marketing and relevant partner teams, not only within the content workflow.

 - Measure leverage through throughput, cycle time, cost, adoption, quality, and business impact; evolve the system each quarter.

Lead thought leadership and executive voice

 - Set the operating model for executive publishing and advise leaders on the arguments Oyster should make publicly.

 - Turn proprietary employment, salary, and hiring data into a durable original-research programme that shapes external conversation.

 - Mobilize newsletter, podcast, events, PR, analyst relations, Product Marketing, partner/customer storytelling, and social around shared narratives.

Own business impact

 - Connect editorial and narrative decisions to company growth, customer trust, target-account engagement, earned influence, and pipeline.

 - Build reporting that enables executives and teams to make better portfolio and investment decisions.

 - Identify emerging market shifts early and recommend company responses before they become obvious.

Mobilize the extended organization

 - Set direction for senior stakeholders, freelancers, agencies, specialists, and subject-matter experts without relying on formal authority.

 - Create decision rights, operating rhythms, and shared standards that enable multiple teams to execute consistently.

 - Define the long-term roadmap and future organizational shape of the capability, including what remains expert-led, becomes a system, or requires hiring.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for the top and mid funnel of n8n’s commercial engine, helping Marketing leadership make sharper investment decisions across both our PLG and SLG motions.

To do so, you’ll turn demand, funnel, and marketing investment decisions into an integrated financial view that leadership can act on:


OWN MARKETING PLANNING & FORECASTING

 - Drive n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for Marketing end to end, from top-down targets and cross-functional alignment through regional segmentation, budget ownership, and consolidation into the company plan.

 - Partner with Marketing budget owners across demand generation, brand, community and DevRel, product marketing, and events to set budgets, forecast spend, and sharpen investment trade-offs.

 - Own program spend with the same rigor as headcount, including agency and media contracts, event and sponsorship commitments, phasing, seasonality, and in-year reallocations.


MODEL FUNNEL & CHANNEL ECONOMICS

 - Model demand creation, signup and MQL volume, activation, qualified opportunity, conversion, and velocity with Marketing Ops and RevOps across both PLG and SLG motions.

 - Translate funnel and channel levers into the demand assumptions behind n8n’s integrated top-line model and quantify the financial impact and trade-offs of changing them.

 - Assess CAC and payback, conversion, pipeline contribution, and expected versus realized ROI using attribution, incrementality testing, and other causal methods where appropriate.


BUILD A RIGOROUS MARKETING INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK

 - Establish a repeatable process for material marketing bets covering hypothesis, baseline, expected return, confidence range, leading indicators, scale-or-stop triggers, and post-investment review.

 - Build and defend investment cases for brand, community, content, events, and other spend that does not attribute cleanly to closed revenue.

 - Use internal evidence, external benchmarks, and post-investment learnings to drive in-year reallocations toward the highest-impact opportunities.


TURN DATA INTO DECISIONS

 - Partner with Marketing Ops, RevOps, Data, and Controlling to keep the financial view aligned with n8n’s attribution, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

 - Own the financial metric definitions behind Marketing reporting and ensure teams are operating from a consistent view of performance.

 - Turn financial reporting and variance analysis into tangible insights and recommendations for Marketing leadership, executives, and board-level audiences when needed.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 📊 FP&A experience: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally in a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

 - 🗂️ Complex planning experience: You have led complex, multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes end to end.

 - 🤝 Marketing business partnering: You have deep demand-side finance partnering experience in either a self-serve/PLG funnel or an enterprise/SLG demand generation motion, plus a strong working understanding of the other.

 - 📈 Funnel and channel economics: You are fluent in CAC and CAC payback by channel and motion, blended versus paid CAC, CLV/CAC, pipeline attribution, funnel conversion, and velocity.

 - 💶 Program spend ownership: You are comfortable owning a budget weighted toward program spend, including commitments, phasing, agency costs, vendor economics, and reallocations.

 - 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain robust as assumptions, scenarios, and operating inputs change.

 - 🗣️ Executive communication: You translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to Marketing leadership, executives, and board audiences when needed.

 - 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You naturally use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your planning, reporting, and analysis.

ashby:harvey:0cc0c934-ce13-483b-8a11-995.full_description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.







ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is looking for a driven, strategic, and entrepreneurial Sales Development Manager to lead and scale our SDR team across EMEA. This will be the first dedicated SDR leadership role in the region, responsible for building a high-performing team that generates pipeline across leading law firms, professional services organizations, and in-house legal teams.

You will own hiring, onboarding, coaching, and performance management while partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to build a scalable pipeline generation engine. You’ll also help shape Harvey’s regional go-to-market strategy by refining targeting, messaging, and outbound programs that resonate with the European legal market.

If you’re excited by the idea of building teams, developing talent, and driving impact at a fast-growing AI company transforming legal work, we’d love to meet you.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own regional pipeline performance: Drive the SDR team’s contribution to pipeline generation across inbound and outbound channels, ensuring strong alignment with EMEA sales targets.

 - Build and scale the team: Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing SDR team, helping establish the structure, operating cadence, and performance standards for the EMEA region.

 - Coach and develop SDRs: Deliver hands-on coaching through regular 1:1s, call reviews, and deal strategy sessions to accelerate rep development and performance.

 - Design onboarding and enablement: Partner with GTM enablement to create onboarding and ongoing training programs that ramp SDRs quickly and build strong product, industry, and prospecting expertise.

 - Partner cross-functionally: Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to improve lead routing, campaign effectiveness, and pipeline conversion.

 - Refine targeting and messaging: Continuously test and improve outbound strategies, messaging, and account targeting based on ICP fit and performance insights.

 - Leverage data and tools: Use platforms such as Salesforce, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, and ZoomInfo to track team performance and optimize workflows.

 - Build a strong team culture: Foster a high-performance culture grounded in ownership, learning, and collaboration.



WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4+ years of experience in SaaS sales or business development, with at least 1–2 years of direct SDR or BDR leadership experience.

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

As the Director of Customer Support, you will be instrumental in expanding Crusoe's growing Customer Support organization and driving the adoption of Crusoe Cloud. This leadership role demands a strategic thinker who can develop and execute comprehensive account playbooks, ensuring quarter-over-quarter growth. This role requires a leader who is technical, comfortable getting hands on with issues, and confident joining customer calls when needed.

You will build and manage a high-performing support team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and customer advocacy. You will partner closely with engineering, SRE, product, and operations teams to improve reliability, enhance support workflows, and deliver validated, production ready infrastructure to customers..  We’re looking for someone who has built support organizations at scale, implemented support procedures, and knows how to operate in a fast paced, high growth environment.



What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Build, lead, and scale Crusoe’s global Customer Support organization.

 - Develop and implement comprehensive account playbooks to drive Crusoe Cloud adoption and growth.

 - Manage and mentor teams troubleshooting issues across networking, Infiniband, distributed training, containerization, and large scale AI/ML workloads.

 - Work closely with engineering, SRE, and product to improve reliability and proactively address customer impacting issues.

 - Drive initiatives to reduce escalations, incidents, and outages, leveraging key KPIs and observability data.

 - Build and evolve a tiered support structure to support enterprise and AI-native customers at scale.

 - Translate support insights into clear recommendations for executive leadership.



What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - Leadership & Customer Operations Expertise:
   
   - 8–10+ years in customer support/operations leadership, ideally in cloud, infrastructure, or AI driven environments.
   
   - Proven ability to build and lead high-performing customer support teams.
   
   - Experience building support procedures, global processes, and structured escalation paths.
   
   - Ability to develop and implement customer tier support structures.

 - Technical & Strategic Acumen:
   
   - Technical expertise in one orchestration/scheduling technology, Linux, virtualization, and storage skills.
   
   - Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, distributed training frameworks, and inference systems.
   
   - Ability to speak at a technical level and think strategically about account growth.
   
   - Comfortable working with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. 
     

 - Problem-Solving & Collaboration:
   
   - Comfortable stepping into high-pressure customer situations and stabilizing escalations.
   
   - Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams.
   
   - Strong ability to drive initiatives to reduce incidents and improve customer experience.



Key Requirements:

 - Proven experience in building and scaling customer support organizations.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise and tiered support models.

 - Ability to develop and implement strategic account playbooks.

 - Technical proficiency across cloud, Linux, container ecosystems, and/or distributed systems.

 - Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional influence.

 - Experience supporting or working with AI/ML infrastructure is a strong plus.

The GCO Channel Analyst plays a critical role within the GCO Finance organization at Logitech, providing analytical support and financial insights to optimize channel performance, drive revenue growth, and enhance decision-making across our global channel teams.

The primary business interactions are the Global organization and Regional Channel teams. From a functional side, there are frequent interactions with the Cluster Business Finance, Business Operations and Global GTM Finance.

workday:logitech:147866.full_description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Position Summary:

● Department: Controllership Finance – Global Payroll Team

● Location: Cork, Ireland

● Contract Type: Full Time / Permanent

● Region Coverage: EMEA & Global Payroll Transformation (EMEA)


About the Role: As an integral member of Logitech Finance, you will work in a fast-paced, dynamic Global Payroll team processing payrolls across the EMEA region. You will play a dual role: ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery for selected countries, while acting as a key representative on the Global Payroll Transformation team to re-engineer, automate, and modernize our global payroll operations.


Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and Do.


In this role you will:

● Ensure the accurate and timely processing of Logitech’s end-to-end payroll for selected EMEA countries.

● Collaborate with payroll partners to collect and validate all payroll inputs, including salaries, bonuses, benefits, allowances, and deductions. Conduct rigorous pre- and post-payroll reconciliations to eliminate anomalies or duplicate records before finalization.

● Ensure the accurate and timely completion of payroll fiscal close procedures, including journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations. Work with the broader Finance team to identify and resolve payroll accounting exceptions.

● Understand the full payroll cycle through to GL bookings and present meaningful flux analysis to stakeholders.

● Stay current on and ensure strict compliance with local payroll regulations, tax laws, social security, and benefits requirements across various EMEA jurisdictions.

● Ensure compliance with payroll internal controls, maintaining robust documentation and proactively identifying and remediating any control gaps or weaknesses. Assist in facilitating internal and external audit engagements.

● Partner with key stakeholders including People Services, HRIS, Compensation & Benefits, Stock Admin, and Finance to troubleshoot issues and work collaboratively to develop optimum processes and service delivery.

● Drive the Global Finance Transformation roadmap across EMEA, focusing on eliminating manual workflows, standardizing regional processes, and implementing scalable, automated payroll solutions.

● Collaborate with internal and external partners to evaluate, test, and deploy emerging technologies to enhance service delivery.


Your Skills & Experience:

Since this role sits directly at the intersection of payroll delivery and global process optimization, it requires an elevated transformation skillset. We are looking for an experienced EMEA payroll professional who pairs deep technical payroll knowledge with a strong technology-first mindset— someone actively passionate about leveraging AI, automation, and data to transform enterprise payroll. For consideration, you must bring the following skills, experience and behaviours to our team:

● Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in a senior analyst payroll role across the EMEA region.

● Transformation & Technology Focus: Advanced capability and genuine interest in applying emerging technologies—such as AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Robotic Process Automation (RPA)—to eliminate manual touchpoints, re-engineer workflows, and unlock strategic workforce insights.

● Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field—or an equivalent payroll certification.

● Regulatory Compliance: Solid understanding of EMEA payroll taxes, statutory deductions, social security, and labour regulations across multiple European jurisdictions.

● Spreadsheet Skills: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets (must be comfortable using Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and managing large data sets).

● Familiarity with how HRIS data flows into downstream payroll and Finance/GL systems.

● Strong ability to perform pre- and post-payroll reconciliations, investigate gross-to-net variances, and flag data errors before finalization.

● Experience supporting month-end close procedures, including preparing journal entries and assisting Finance/FP&A teams with cost analysis.

● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to partner effectively across HR, Finance, and external vendors.

● Ability to stay organized and solve problems independently in a fast-paced, global team environment.

● Customer service focus with the ability and sound judgment to handle highly sensitive information.

● Process improvement mindset: have a passion for reengineering payroll processes in implementing a first-class payroll service.


ABOUT LOGITECH With a fast-moving, innovative culture and a strong balance sheet, Logitech is a world leader in products that connect people to the digital experiences they care most about. Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location: Utrecht, Netherlands or Cork, Ireland

Working Model: Hybrid (2-3 days/week)

The Team and Role:

At Logitech, Customer Supply Chain (CSC) plays a critical role in delivering an outstanding customer experience while enabling sustainable business growth. As our organization continues to evolve, Global CSC Transformation is focused on accelerating business capabilities, driving process excellence, enabling digital innovation and fostering collaboration across our Global CSC network. 

As the Global CSC Transformation Manager, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and executing the transformation agenda for Global Customer Supply Chain. Working closely with Regional CSC Heads, you will lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives that improve operational excellence, strengthen customer collaboration, accelerate digital and AI adoption, and enhance the capabilities of our global CSC organization.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills. You will partner with Global & Regional CSC Heads, and cross-functional stakeholders across Planning, Commercial, IT, Digital, Data & Analytics and Finance to align priorities, drive execution and deliver meaningful business outcomes. Success in this role depends on your ability to build trusted relationships, influence without direct authority and navigate a highly matrixed global environment.

Beyond delivering transformation initiatives, you will proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify ways of working and introduce innovative solutions that create measurable value for both the business and our customers. You will contribute to the continuous evolution of Global CSC capabilities while helping embed a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement across the organization.

Your Contribution:

  • Drive customer-centric transformation by improving customer journey, service experience and cross-functional collaboration across the order-to-cash process.

  • Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve ways of working and accelerate organizational capabilities.

  • Leading cross-functional initiatives that enable digital transformation, AI adoption and process standardization.

  • Promoting collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement across the Global CSC organization.

  • Contributing to the development of scalable capabilities that enhance customer experience, operational excellence and long-term business growth.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.

  • Strong financial acumen with experience developing business cases, establishing governance and KPIs, and measuring transformation success through ROI and benefits realization.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting organizational change and driving adoption of new processes, tools or ways of working.

  • Self-starter with a continuous improvement mindset, strong ownership and the ability to navigate ambiguity.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.

Job Description:

Position Summary


As a Manufacturing Engineer, you will be a key member of the site engineering team, responsible for ensuring that our high-reliability discrete semiconductor products meet stringent customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. You will own product and process definition through part requirement analysis and test flow selection, ensuring products are correctly processed through electrical screening and sampling operations in accordance with applicable military, aerospace, and internal specification test methods.

You will develop and maintain robust process controls, drive automation initiatives, and contribute to continuous improvement in yield, quality, throughput, and cost of ownership.


The Manufacturing Engineering team in Ennis comprises two disciplines: electrical and mechanical. This position focuses on electrical engineering support for the site, including back-end test and reliability screening operations.


Working Pattern


This is a day shift position. The successful candidate will work Monday - Friday, 08:00 – 16:30.


Why Join Us


You will receive structured in-house training and be coached and mentored by senior engineers with deep expertise in high-reliability semiconductor manufacturing — an excellent platform to build a career in a specialized, high-value segment of the industry.


Role Focus

  • Lead and support project work on high-reliability screening operations, including High Temperature Reverse Bias (HTRB), burn-in, and electrical test/screening methodologies.
  • Partner with site engineers on equipment appraisal and qualification initiatives, driving process standardization, quality improvement, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) enhancements.
  • Develop deep knowledge of products, processes, and test equipment to provide technical direction on product disposition through screening and sampling process steps.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable industry test methods, standards, and customer source-control requirements.

Key Responsibilities


  • Apply reliability engineering theory and principles (e.g., failure mechanisms, acceleration models, screening effectiveness) to Microchip products and manufacturing processes.
  • Drive data analysis, statistical process control (SPC), and root cause / corrective action (RCCA) activities to resolve yield, quality, and equipment issues and to sustain continuous improvement.
  • Originate and develop technical solutions, process advancements, and automation initiatives that strengthen Microchip's position as an industry leader in high-reliability discrete semiconductors.
  • Create and maintain process and product documentation, including test flows, specifications, and associated process controls.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (Level 8) in Engineering or Physics; Electronic/Electrical Engineering preferred.
  • Exposure to continuous improvement and quality methodologies — Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, DOE, DMAIC, FMEA, SPC — is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with semiconductor device physics, discrete power devices (e.g., diodes and bipolar transistors), or ATE/electrical test environments is an advantage but not essential.

Essential Skills and Attributes


  • Strong grasp of electrical engineering fundamentals and semiconductor device behavior.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and apply detailed product and process knowledge.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Effective written and verbal communica

The Staff Manufacturing Engineer is a senior individual-contributor role providing technical leadership for manufacturing engineering within J&J Vision Care, Limerick. Senior Manufacturing Engineer, J&J, Vision, Limerick, Ireland


This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Manufacturing Engineer to support manufacturing performance, process capability, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced, highly automated, and regulated manufacturing environment.


In this role, you will provide strong engineering support across manufacturing operations, helping to improve process capability, equipment performance, quality, and output. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, deliver engineering projects, and implement practical, compliant solutions that support safe, efficient, and reliable manufacturing.




As Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you will:


− Support the deployment of manufacturing and automation solutions that improve process capability, equipment performance, quality, and output within assigned manufacturing areas.

− Support the design, installation, qualification, optimisation, and improvement of manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, and controls.

− Provide troubleshooting support for process and equipment issues using structured problem-solving, data analysis, and sound engineering judgement.

− Partner with operations, quality, maintenance, validation, supply chain, and other engineering teams to implement robust and compliant manufacturing solutions.

− Identify and deliver continuous improvement initiatives that enhance yield, reduce cost, increase capacity, and improve manufacturing performance.

− Lead or support technical projects from concept through implementation, ensuring clear execution, risk management, and timely communication of progress and outcomes.

− Ensure timely and effective completion of Quality System deliverables including CAPAs, non-conformances, audit actions, change controls, and associated technical documentation.

− Ensure safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements are fully integrated into the design, purchase, modification, and operation of new and existing manufacturing equipment.

− Support plant and engineering strategic initiatives by bringing technical expertise, urgency, and execution focus to critical business priorities.

− Champion a culture of environmental, health, and safety excellence by ensuring all activities are carried out responsibly and in full compliance with site and company expectations.



Essential:


− A bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Process, Automation, or a related Engineering discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

− Minimum of 4 years’ engineering experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, with demonstrated capability in troubleshooting, process improvement, and project delivery.

− The ability to take ownership, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

− Strong communication, teamwork

ashby:Vanta:31cdf07c-21ab-460c-912e-f288.full_description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



Our Staff Software Engineers identify key strategic technical initiatives, deliver significant value to our customers and business, and set the tone for engineering excellence and culture. As a Staff Software Engineer on the team based in London, you will play a key role in growing our engineering presence in Europe. You'll partner with product management, product design, and your growing engineering team to drive the discovery and development of privacy, AI, and risk management features that expand Vanta’s value for its customers - working in a domain where technical decisions carry real compliance and data-governance weight, not just product tradeoffs. Your work will accelerate product development and create a consistent customer experience for all of our customer segments.



Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business.



Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.



This role is remote-first. For engineers based in the London area, we ask for 2–3 days per week in the office. For engineers based elsewhere in the UK/Ireland, we expect occasional travel to London (roughly once per quarter, <20% of your time).



Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. We’d love for you to join us!



What you’ll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

 - Identify, scope, and lead large technical projects, laying the groundwork for core products to evolve and scale into highly performant, reliable, and customizable systems

 - Design, develop, and own new product functionality and/or infrastructure leveraging modern frameworks and tooling (TypeScript, React, Node.js)

 - Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation

 - Set technical direction that shapes how multiple teams build in the privacy and AI governance spaces - not just a single project's outcome

 - Help stand up and shape engineering practices as we grow our footprint in the UK/Ireland, including interviewing, hiring, and onboarding new teammates

 - Act as a cultural beacon, setting a high bar for engineering culture and excellence, and multiply the impact of the teams around you through mentorship and technical leadership



How to be successful in this role:

 - At least 10 years of industry experience as a software engineer

 - Served as a technical lead for large projects (6+ months in length), including defining the roadmap for complex projects spanning multiple teams and functions

 - Have set technical direction or built systems whose impact extended beyond your immediate team - e.g., shared infrastructure, cross-team standards, or platform decisions other teams built on

 - Built successful SaaS products for both startup and enterprise users

 - Have previous startup experience, or worked in an environment that prioritizes a bias for action

 - Upleveled teams of engineers by mentoring and leading by example

 - Experience working at rapidly scaling startups and large companies, especially with environments that prioritize a bias for action



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents 

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

 - Commuter benefits and lunch allowance for team members who attend the office

 - Pension matching

 - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

 - 8 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team-building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

workday:microchiphr:R2607-26.description: Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity,…
workday:microchiphr:R2607-26.full_description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description:

Shape the Next Generation of FPGA and SoC Technology

We are seeking an experienced SoC Validation Engineer to lead silicon bring-up, system validation, and debug activities for advanced FPGA and SoC products. Working across hardware, firmware, and system architecture teams, you will drive features from prototype through production, ensuring robust, high-quality solutions for our customers.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, developing embedded software, and uncovering root causes in both lab and silicon environments.

What You'll Do

  • Lead SoC validation, silicon bring-up, and system-level debug activities.

  • Develop validation plans, diagnostic software, and bare-metal firmware for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V platforms.

  • Debug complex hardware, firmware, and system interactions using industry-standard lab equipment and tools.

  • Validate key interfaces and subsystems including PCIe, Ethernet, USB, SPI, I²C, UART, timers, and watchdogs.

  • Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and physical design teams.

  • Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of issues discovered in simulation, emulation, FPGA prototypes, and silicon.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical excellence across the team.

  • Leverage automation and AI-assisted development tools to improve validation efficiency and productivity.

Requirements/Qualifications:

Required

  • Master's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering with 12+ years

  • Strong background in FPGA/SoC architectures, silicon validation, and system-level debug.

  • Experience developing embedded software in C/C++ and bare-metal firmware for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V processors.

  • Hands-on laboratory experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and FPGA debug tools.

  • Knowledge of JTAG, SVF, IEEE 1532, STAPL, and common embedded peripherals and interfaces.

  • Familiarity with Verilog/VHDL and FPGA development flows.

  • Excellent communication skills and a passion for quality engineering.

Preferred

  • High-speed SERDES bring-up and debug experience.

  • Knowledge of PCIe Gen3/4/5, Ethernet, USB 3.x, JESD204C, Interlaken, or related protocols.

  • Experience with Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, Perl, or Tcl.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering

Why Join Us?

You'll work at the forefront of FPGA and SoC innovation, tackling challenging validation problems and helping bring cutting-edge silicon products to market. This role offers exceptional technical breadth across hardware, firmware, system validation, and high-speed interfaces, with strong opportunities for growth and technical leadership.

Travel Time:

0% - 25%

Job Description:

Shape the Next Generation of FPGA and SoC Technology

We are seeking an experienced SoC Validation Engineer to lead silicon bring-up, system validation, and debug activities for advanced FPGA and SoC products. Working across hardware, firmware, and system architecture teams, you will drive features from prototype through production, ensuring robust, high-quality solutions for our customers.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, developing embedded software, and uncovering root causes in both lab and silicon environments.

What You'll Do

  • Lead SoC validation, silicon bring-up, and system-level debug activities.

  • Develop validation plans, diagnostic software, and bare-metal firmware for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V platforms.

  • Debug complex hardware, firmware, and system interactions using industry-standard lab equipment and tools.

  • Validate key interfaces and subsystems including PCIe, Ethernet, USB, SPI, I²C, UART, timers, and watchdogs.

  • Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and physical design teams.

  • Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of issues discovered in simulation, emulation, FPGA prototypes, and silicon.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical excellence across the team.

  • Leverage automation and AI-assisted development tools to improve validation efficiency and productivity.

Requirements/Qualifications:

Required

  • BS in Electrical/Computer Engineering with 7+ years' experience, or MS with 6+ years.

  • Strong background in FPGA/SoC architectures, silicon validation, and system-level debug.

  • Experience developing embedded software in C/C++ and bare-metal firmware for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V processors.

  • Hands-on laboratory experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and FPGA debug tools.

  • Knowledge of JTAG, SVF, IEEE 1532, STAPL, and common embedded peripherals and interfaces.

  • Familiarity with Verilog/VHDL and FPGA development flows.

  • Excellent communication skills and a passion for quality engineering.

Preferred

  • High-speed SERDES bring-up and debug experience.

  • Knowledge of PCIe Gen3/4/5, Ethernet, USB 3.x, JESD204C, Interlaken, or related protocols.

  • Experience with Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, Perl, or Tcl.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar technologies.

Why Join Us?

You'll work at the forefront of FPGA and SoC innovation, tackling challenging validation problems and helping bring cutting-edge silicon products to market. This role offers exceptional technical breadth across hardware, firmware, system validation, and high-speed interfaces, with strong opportunities for growth and technical leadership.

Job Description:

Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

 

Join a mature international team analyzing cyberthreat information from a variety of sources to produce intelligence which effectively communicates threats relevant to Fidelity.

 

We are seeking a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst to join our team to identify, track, and report on cyberthreats relevant to Fidelity. This role sits at the intersection of threat analysis and technical knowledge, requiring someone who can translate raw cyber threat data into actionable intelligence for both operational and executive audiences.

 

  • Triage and enrich indicators of compromise (IOCs), perform basic threat hunting and integrate with security tooling including a threat intelligence platform.
  • Ingest, normalize, and correlate structured (e.g., IOC feeds) and unstructured data (e.g., OSINT, dark web, reports) to produce actionable threat intelligence and support detection and response efforts.   
  • Assist analysts and incident response during cyber investigations.
  • Identify and assess the potential impact of cyberthreat activity, including exploits of vulnerabilities and impact within the financial industry. 
  • Evaluate and apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies to expand the cyberthreat intelligence team’s collection, enrichment and analytic capabilities.
  • Perform open-source intelligence (OSINT) collection and analysis across dark web forums, social media and threat feeds.
  • Map adversary behavior at a granular level and collaborate with stakeholders to develop or refine detection rules and threat mitigation steps.
  • Produce finished intelligence products including strategic briefings and tactical advisories tailored to varied audiences (executive management, security operations center, fraud and other stakeholders).
  • Participate in information-sharing communities and coordinate with FS-ISAC and trusted industry partners. 

  • Qualifications
    Required
  • 3+ years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or a related security discipline.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of named threat actors, Tactics Techniques and Procedures and current threat landscape trends.
  • Familiarity with intelligence analysis frameworks and structured analytic techniques (e.g., Diamond Model, Kill Chain, Intelligence Cycle, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX).
  • Experience producing written intelligence products for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort and experience with structured and unstructured data, including indicators, metadata, and contextual threat information.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work productively as part of a team and alongside key stakeholders.
    Desired
  • Strong technical curiosity, including a willingness to explore, experiment, and ask “why” and “how” to drive deeper understanding of cyberthreat events and new technology.
  • Knowledge of Mac endpoints and associated threats.
  • Experience leveraging AI/LLM tooling to accelerate intelligence workflows.
  • Knowledge of Threat Intelligence Platform integrations, API connectors, and automation pipelines. 
  • Industry certifications such as GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Security + and other related credentials.
  • Basic scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python or similar) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of geopolitical concerns and issues of countries hosting Fidelity businesses and associates.
  • Familiarity with malware analysis concepts (static and dynamic), threat hunting, and, at a broad level, how cybercriminals operate. 
  • Prior experience in financial services, critical infrastructure, or government intelligence environments. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work productively as part of a team and alongside key stakeholders. 
  • Presentation skills, verbally communicating threats to both technical and non-technical audiences and using slides effectively. 
  • Hands‑on exposure to active nation‑state and cybercriminal threat activity, coupled with practical experience using emerging AI tools and features.
  • Opportunity to build new capabilities.undefinedSupport for training, conferences, and certification pursuits.
  • A collaborative team environment focused on continuous learning and professional development.

Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

Currently, we have a few open positions from our client, an AI-native cloud company. AI teams use its platform to run inference on open-source models, fine-tune them and rent large GPU clusters. The fleet is set to grow about 10×; the team won't. That's where you come in.

 

Who they’re looking for: Site Reliability Engineer, Senior Back-end Developer with Golang, Senior Back-end Developer with Python, AI Infrastructure Engineer, Distributed Storage Engineer, DevOps.

 

Requirements for Senior Back-end Developers with Golang

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Golang
  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
  • 1+ year of experience in AI-assisted coding
  • Experience with distributed systems

 

Requirements for Senior Back-end Developers with Python

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Python

  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Linux

  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes

  • 1+ year of experience in AI-assisted coding

  • Experience with distributed systems

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue, design and build the solution, and ship it to production

  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)

  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls

  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision

  • You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks

 

Other job listings you can check using the link. You will be redirected to the career page with offers from the client on our website.

 

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile
  2. Verify your role
  3. Once approved, we match you with a project.

 

Ready? Apply!

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Enterprise Software Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & An gular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Node & TypeScript, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Saudi Arabia, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

ashby:oyster:e6ff4ecf-cb05-4ce6-88b5-aee.full_description:
✨ ONE PLATFORM, A WHOLE WORLD OF OPPORTUNITY



The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.



We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:



 - Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time 

 - Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award by Newsweek

 - A G2 Spring 2026 Leader https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026 across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

 - The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023



Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.



And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.




THE ROLE

Location: While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be currently based within the EMEA region.

At Oyster, we’re on a mission to create a more equal world by making it possible for companies everywhere to hire people anywhere.

Joining as a Business Development Representative (BDR) is your chance to break into tech sales and build a career with real growth potential. From day one, you will be supported by dedicated sales enablement, training, and coaching programs designed to help you succeed and grow.

You will learn how to master outreach, qualify leads, and build relationships that drive business results — all while working with top-tier sales tools like Salesforce, Salesloft, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You won’t be on your own. You will be surrounded by Business Development leaders, experienced Sales Executives, Revenue Operations experts, and an Enablement team that will invest in your development every step of the way.

This is an opportunity to learn fast, make an impact, and grow in a global, high-performing sales environment. If you are curious, ambitious, and ready to develop your career in tech sales, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities :

 - Create awareness and generate interest in Oyster through outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, and social outreach)

 - Partner seamlessly with Sales Executives to drive mid-market and SMB pipeline velocity

 - Qualify and schedule high-value meetings that convert into tangible sales opportunities

 - Present and clearly articulate Oyster’s global employment platform to target buyers

 - Organize, optimize, and manage your pipeline for maximum efficiency and predictable results

 - Serve as the voice of the market, collaborating with the GTM team (Sales, Marketing, Product, etc.) to translate buyer intelligence into strategy.

What we value:

 - Driven & Motivated: You have a clear “why” that goes beyond money — whether it’s purpose, product, or personal growth

 - Ownership & Accountability: You take initiative, learn from mistakes, and find proactive solutions to move forward

 - Growth Mindset: You actively seek and implement feedback, always looking for ways to improve, master your craft, and ensure your career progression.

 - Resilient & Persistent: You don’t give up easily. You push through challenges and adapt in turbulent times

 - T.E.A.M.Oriented: Together Everyone Achieves More! You thrive in a collaborative environment, consistently seeking to elevate your teammates, celebrate team success, all while maintaining your own high standards for results

What will make you successful:

 - Strategic Researcher: Finding the information is not your destination; you are naturally curious and synthesize data from diverse sources to strategically guide and focus outreach efforts.

 - Organized Precision: You possess exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, consistently producing accurate work while balancing speed and quality--especially under pressure.

 - Creative Problem-Solver: Deconstructing complex challenges into practical steps to generate effective and innovative solutions comes second nature to you.

 - Agile and Adaptable: You are open and amenable to change, quickly mastering new tools (including AI) and processes, and swiftly pivoting strategies to progress the pipeline

 - Data-Driven Communicator : You view data as your currency for success, leveraging clear and persuasive communication (both written and verbal) as the vehicle to drive action.

Candidates who stand out possess:

 - Minimum 6 months of demonstrated success in a customer-centric role (e.g., sales, hospitality, customer success, recruiting) where your results demonstrably relied on proactively engaging people and cultivating genuine relationships to drive a specific, measurable outcome.

 - Familiarity with B2B prospecting tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)

 - A genuine passion for remote work and an active curiosity about the evolving trends shaping the global workplace

You'll also need

 - A reliable home internet connection (or be able to get one)

 - Fluent English language skills

ashby:n8n:01e97911-afbc-4d4b-bdc7-ea6cd5.full_description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build one of n8n’s most predictable Enterprise sales teams. You’ll develop high-performing Enterprise AEs, instill forecast and pipeline discipline, and create a repeatable operating model that wins complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

To make that happen, you’ll be hands-on in coaching, deal inspection, and team development day-to-day, while staying close enough to strategic deals and customer executives to raise the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win:




DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING, PREDICTABLE TEAM

 - Coach and develop a team of Enterprise AEs through structured 1:1s, field coaching, and deal reviews, raising both the floor and the ceiling on individual performance.

 - Build a rigorous forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes your numbers predictable quarter over quarter, not dependent on late-quarter heroics.

 - Create a repeatable operating model with clear playbooks, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC-based deal inspection, and coaching rhythms, so execution doesn’t rely on you personally driving every strategic deal.

 - Hire, onboard, and scale the team quickly, establishing career paths and succession plans as we grow.


SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR YOUR TERRITORY

 - Prioritize and run your Enterprise territory with focus, balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong.

 - Set the strategy for the team’s most complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, staying close enough to coach without taking the pen.

 - Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical and business wins.


BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION

 - Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution.

 - Orchestrate executive engagement across your accounts, aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals.

 - Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy.


PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process.




REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

 - 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: You have 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals.

 - 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: You have deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record of coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection.

 - 📈 Forecast & pipeline rigor: You’ve run a disciplined forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes revenue predictable, not reactive.

 - 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals.

 - 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes.

 - 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback.

 - 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum.

 - 🇬🇧 Location:  You're based in the UK, Ireland or a European country where we hire (not France, Italy, Sweden, Switzerland or Romania), and happy to travel regularly to meet clients across the Nordics, Benelux, the Middle East and Africa.

 - 🇬🇧 English: You’re a native or bilingual speaker of English.

 - 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: You have experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions.

 - 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion.

Nice-to-haves

 - Additional languages: You're fluent in a regional language (e.g. Dutch, Arabic, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish).

 - 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: You’ve worked in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories.

 - 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving, and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down.

 - 📊 Operational excellence: You have strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution.

workday:fmr:2136849.full_description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to join a squad developing applications for the financial industry. You will build and enhance investment products that help our customers deliver financial solutions.

 

The Expertise We’re Looking For

 

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Experience building applications with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience developing user interfaces with Angular, including enhancing existing screens and building new ones.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and business colleagues.
  • Strong attention to detail, including careful review of requirements, code, and tests.
  • Experience writing automated tests and working with testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Git, build tools, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Understanding of API design, application design principles, and secure coding practices.
  • Exposure to AWS or other cloud infrastructure is a plus.

 

The Skills You Bring

 

  • Producing high-quality code, with high test coverage, following Fidelity processes, standards, and methodologies
  • Ensuring systems in your assigned area are robust, resilient and stable
  • Leveraging approved AI tools across the software development lifecycle to support design, coding, testing, and documentation, while validating outputs and following data security policies.
  • You will contribute to the end-to-end delivery of requirements and user stories, helping ensure they meet the needs and expectations of our business partners.
  • You will contribute to applications that support the financial wellbeing of Fidelity Investments customers.

 

The Value You Deliver

 

  • Work with a multi-functional team to understand project objectives, use cases and systems design requirements.
  • Development of original and innovative technical solutions.
  • Look beyond individual business requirements considering the overall solution.
  • You are a collaborative teammate who can work independently across local and distributed teams.
  • Share your knowledge across the team.

 

How Your Work Impacts the Organization

 

The position aligns to the Capital Markets division of FI Tech – Fidelity Institutional Technology. Capital Markets is the institutional trading arm of Fidelity, delivering brokerage and trading solutions worldwide for institutional and retail customers. The engineering team provides software engineering, application development and project management for Capital Markets applications. FBT group provide technical solutions for the Fidelity Institutional business (FI).

Job Description:

The Role

The Cyber Data Analytics chapter within the Enterprise Cybersecurity organization is seeking a Data Engineer to join our team. You will be at the center of building, maintaining and securing scalable data solutions, including complex data pipelines, migrations, sophisticated data models. Our team serves as a proactive shield against internal and external cyber threats focusing on Identity and Access Management, supporting multiple executive leaders with high-impact analytics for decision-making. 

 

The Expertise and Skills You Bring 

 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
  • 2-5 years of relevant work experience in data engineering and data analysis. 
  • Strong SQL skills and knowledge of multiple RDBMS, specifically Snowflake (including SnowSQL), Postgres, SQL Server and Oracle. 
  • Proven data analysis skills to ensure data quality such as accuracy, consistency and completeness and to identify gaps and anomalies. 
  • Proven experience building data pipelines using Python, with NiFi and dbt knowledge being a significant advantage. 
  • Experience in building Power BI Reports that transform data into aesthetically appealing visuals. 
  • Hands-on knowledge of AWS infrastructure, including S3, EC2, RDS, EKS, Batch, and CloudFormation. 
  • Good understanding of data modeling principles, specifically 3NF and Star Schema models. 
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows using Jenkins and GitHub for automated deployment. 
  • Familiarity with workload scheduling and orchestration tools like Control-M. 
  • Ability to work independently in an Agile environment (Scrum and Kanban) brings technical stories to completion. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Design and build scalable data solutions, including data processing pipelines, migrations, and complex data modeling. 
  • Perform data analysis to assure data quality in terms of accuracy, consistency and completeness and to identify gaps and anomalies.
  • Collaborate with product owners and business partners to translate high-level requirements into actionable technical tasks. 
  • Analyze and manipulate datasets to ensure rigorous data integrity, accessibility, and security throughout the entire lifecycle. 
  • Integrate automated testing and continuous validation into the sprint cycle to ensure production reliability.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Corporate Security Operations Analyst

Overview
Mastercard is seeking a Senior Vulnerability Analyst to manage the Bug Bounty Program and perform advanced application security testing across web, mobile, and API environments. This role is responsible for validating externally reported vulnerabilities, conducting penetration testing, partnering with engineering teams on remediation, and helping strengthen Mastercard's security posture through proactive security assessments and vulnerability management.

Role
• Manage the Bug Bounty Program, including vulnerability intake, validation, triage, and researcher engagement.
• Conduct penetration testing of web, mobile, and API-based applications.
• Assess risk, prioritize findings, and provide remediation guidance.
• Partner with product and engineering teams to drive timely remediation and validate fixes.
• Develop reporting and metrics to measure program effectiveness and communicate risk.

All About You
• At least 3 years of experience in application security and penetration testing
• Strong knowledge of web, mobile, and API security, including OWASP Top 10 risks.
• Hands-on experience with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or similar testing platforms.
• Ability to assess vulnerabilities, communicate risk, and provide actionable remediation guidance.
• Strong stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
• Experience with bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs and relevant security certifications is a plus.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
